description: Bundesnetzagentur Mobilfunkmonitor is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesnetzagentur. The map shall represent the information provided by mobile network operators on mobile network coverage. The provider-neutral area coverage with the mobile radio standards 2G, 4G and 5G in the outdoor area is shown. In addition, the specification 5G Standalone (5G SA) is shown separately in the map. The publisher named on the listing is Bundesnetzagentur. Its keywords include Bundesnetzagentur, Netzabdeckung, GSM, Mobilfunkmonitor, LTE. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
